svg.text: SVG · type outlined · no font dependency
The default signature. The Z is the badge, set inline with the type rather than beside it.
For 16 px, use the favicon cut — same grid, tighter ground.
One colour, modules genuinely transparent — the background shows through the Z.
A 6 × 6 module field. The Z occupies the inner 4 × 4.
Module 100, seam 4, no corner radius. The square stays square.
One module of ground frames the Z inside the tile; keep one more outside it — the dashed field.
The Z is the badge itself, set inline at the type's cap height.
Its ground overhangs the cap line and the baseline by one module.
Wordmark: Manrope ExtraBold and Regular, converted to outlines.
Type-safe modular building blocks for Scala
